fortnite.title: Fortnite update: Horrors Worth Facing Together / Fortnite: Override Is Here!

s.headline: Fortnitemares & Override: New Horrors, Sprites, FNAF Bosses
top_changes: New Fortnitemares Islands and Safety in Numbers Quest
Override mode with Sonic, Tetris, Pac-Man inspired areas
Cursed cartridge corrupts BR with new weapons and bosses
Five Nights at Freddy's animatronic bosses at Pizza Parlor
New collectible Sprites with powers; Ranked with abilities off
s.meta_impact: New bosses and mechanics from FNAF and cursed cartridge add horror elements to Battle Royale fights. Sprites introduce collectible powers outside Ranked, shifting strategy toward extraction and leveling. Overrides and themed areas expand exploration and rule-breaking gameplay.

breakdown.name: Cursed Cartridge
breakdown.change: Spreads corruption in BR; adds powerful weapons, mechanics, bosses

breakdown.name: FNAF Animatronics
breakdown.change: Bosses lurk at Freddy Fazbear's Pizza Parlor; defeat to possess suit

breakdown.name: Sprites
breakdown.change: New collectibles with extractable powers; level up collection; Ranked disabled

s.headline: Season 11 Launches with Nightcrawler and New Battle Pass

S11 Battle Pass: The Incursion with 10 new costumes
New seasonal event: The Acts of Kurt Wagner

s.headline: VALORANT 13.10: Replays Bookmarks, Sentinel Tweaks & Gauntlet Glitched
top_changes: Replay bookmarking added for personal use
Sentinel destroy cooldowns reduced to 45s
Assist rules updated for damage and healing
Gauntlet: Glitched adds new abilities, glitches, and balance
Sage Healing Orb targeting improved
buffs: Cypher Spycam: Destroy cooldown reduced 60s to 45s
Killjoy Turret: Destroy cooldown reduced 60s to 45s
Vyse Arc Rose: Destroy cooldown reduced 60s to 45s
Sage Healing Orb: Increased ally targeting accuracy
Gauntlet Hush Flow: Additional charges on Prone to Flight
nerfs: Cypher Spycam: Reclaim cooldown increased 15s to 20s
Blaze Quickburn: Recharge cooldowns increased at levels 2-3
Boom Bot Overclocked: Movement speed and duration reduced
Contingency Redundancy: Added recharge cooldowns and fewer charges
s.meta_impact: Sentinels gain faster resets after utility destruction, promoting earlier setups and mid-round recovery. Updated assists better reward trading and healing impact. Gauntlet mode expands with new abilities and glitches, shifting draft priorities toward versatile upgrades.

s.headline: 26.22: Corki/Rumble buffs, Locke/Yasuo nerfs, TFT standalone client
top_changes: TFT moves to standalone client Nov 4
Corki & Rumble pro-play buffs
Locke & Yasuo nerfs for banrate
Mel midscope with W rework
Doran’s Bow AD reduced for ADCs
buffs: Corki: R damage and ratios increased
Kayle: Q and R cooldowns lowered
Naafiri: Q heal and W AD buffed
Shen: Q monster damage modifier up
Viktor: Health growth and R AP ratio up
nerfs: Locke: Q stack damage and W duration down
Yasuo: Q total AD ratio reduced
Thresh: Base AD and R damage lowered
Mel: Early game power shifted to scaling
Doran’s Bow: Attack damage reduced to 7
s.meta_impact: Corki and Rumble gain viability outside pro play while Locke and Yasuo see reduced dominance. Mel's midscope encourages scaling builds over early aggression. Doran’s Bow nerf pushes ADCs toward Blade and diversifies itemization.
